name: audit-fixture-overrides
_comment: Phase 66 confidence-followup R1. Tests `lpm.overrides` actually take effect on the default greedy resolver path. Pre-R1, both pubgrub and greedy parsed the OverrideSet but only pubgrub's `choose_version` (provider.rs:1185-1207) applied it — greedy.rs accepted `_overrides` (underscored = unused) and shipped `applied_overrides: Vec::new()`, silently dropping every user-declared override. Without the fix, this fixture symmetric-FAILs (both linker modes ship 4.17.21 instead of 4.17.20). With R1, both modes PASS. Fixture pins `lodash` to 4.17.20 via `lpm.overrides`; without the override the resolver would pick 4.17.21 (newest in `^4.0.0`).
